description: Search the Open VSX Registry, where VSCodium, Cursor, Gitpod, Theia and other editors get their VS Code extensions. Read an extension's versions, platform builds, download links and checksums, README, changelog and manifest, check which version works with a given VS Code, read reviews and namespaces, and follow the registry's feed of published and removed versions. A trigger runs a workflow when an extension publishes a new version. No account or API key required.

open_vsx_new_version_trigger.description: Runs when an extension on Open VSX publishes a new version, with whether it is a pre-release, the VS Code versions it needs and its download and changelog links. Optionally only for stable versions or only for pre-releases.
